verdict.rationale: The privacy policy documents linking Google Workspace to grant access to Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive and Docs/Sheets/Slides, and says data is indexed from external sources. Hands-on reports corroborate this: a three-step onboarding with Workspace permissions, the agent acting on that context immediately, and emails indexed and stored for later searches and summaries. missing for 10: connectors beyond Google Workspace (e.g., Outlook/Microsoft 365, Dropbox), hands-on corroboration of Drive and Calendar content being searched and used in answers (only email use is independently shown)
